nodes.name: docker_cleanup.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that prunes stopped Docker containers, unused images, and dangling volumes to reclaim disk space during development.

nodes.name: edge_app_runner_manager.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase Deno Edge Function that exposes a REST endpoint for pausing or resuming AWS App Runner services by ARN, routing `/{service}/pause` and `/{service}/resume` requests to the AWS SDK.
nodes.languageNotes: Deno-based TypeScript; uses `serve()` from Deno standard library and `@aws-sdk/client-apprunner` from npm; dynamically resolves service ARN from env vars named `{SERVICE_KEY}_APP_RUNNER_SERVICE_ARN`.

nodes.name: edge_owntracks-webhook.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase Deno Edge Function webhook that receives OwnTracks location payloads and forwards them to a PGMQ `owntracks` queue via Supabase RPC.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `Deno.serve()` and the Supabase JS client pointed at the `pgmq_public` schema to enqueue messages.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide for the Supabase/Deno edge functions, describing the App Runner manager and OwnTracks webhook functions, local Deno setup, configuration, and how to run and test them.

nodes.name: test_app_runner.py
nodes.summary: Manual integration test script that exercises the App Runner manager edge function's pause and resume endpoints over HTTP.

nodes.name: test_owntracks_webhook.py
nodes.summary: Manual integration test script that sends a synthetic OwnTracks location payload to the Supabase edge function webhook and prints the response.

nodes.name: live_track.sql
nodes.summary: SQL DDL that creates the `live` table for storing OwnTracks GPS location events with battery, coordinates, topic, user/device identifiers, and performance indexes.

nodes.name: live
nodes.summary: Core live-location tracking table storing OwnTracks GPS events including battery level, lat/lon coordinates, topic, user_id, and device_id.

nodes.name: read_pickly_file.py
nodes.summary: Analysis utility that reads serialised OwnTracks location data from pickle files, loads it into an in-memory DuckDB table, and provides rich query functions for spatial and temporal analysis.

nodes.name: read_pickle_file
nodes.summary: Reads one or more pickle files from a directory, deserialises each OwnTracks record, and returns a flat list of location event dicts.

nodes.name: create_duckdb_table
nodes.summary: Converts a list of location event dicts into a Pandas DataFrame and registers it as an in-memory DuckDB view for SQL querying.

nodes.name: query_location_data
nodes.summary: Executes one of several named analytical queries against the DuckDB location table (e.g. trajectory, heatmap, distance summary) and returns results as a dict.

nodes.name: setup_ipykernel_on_startup.py
nodes.summary: IPython kernel startup script that detects the git repository root and prepends it to `sys.path`, ensuring project modules are importable in Jupyter notebooks without manual path management.

nodes.name: uv_setup.md
nodes.summary: Ultra-short reference for the UV package manager setup commands used in this project.

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.name: food_order.sql
nodes.summary: SQL DDL defining the food order schema: a `daily_seq_last_value` helper table, a core food-orders table with pricing breakdown columns, and two order-items tables for regular and takeaway items.

nodes.name: order_num_gen.py
nodes.summary: Provides `create_order_number` and `decode_order_number` helpers that generate and verify reversible, date-salted hash-based order numbers from a WhatsApp recipient number.

nodes.name: create_order_number
nodes.summary: Generates a short, human-readable order number by salting the recipient phone number with today's date and taking characters from a SHA-256 hash.

nodes.name: decode_order_number
nodes.summary: Verifies an encoded order number by regenerating it from the candidate recipient number and confirming it matches, providing an integrity check.

nodes.summary: Commented-out placeholder for future pricing logic functions (`get_min_order_value`, `get_final_order_value`) that will call the external pricing microservice API.

nodes.name: thread_handlers.py
nodes.summary: Early in-memory thread management module providing `get_active_thread`, `create_new_entry`, and `add_new_thread` helpers for associating WhatsApp sender numbers with LangGraph conversation thread IDs.

nodes.name: get_active_thread
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent active thread entry for a given WhatsApp sender number from the in-memory thread dictionary.

nodes.name: create_new_entry
nodes.summary: Creates a new thread entry with a UUID thread ID and ISO timestamp, appending it to the in-memory store for the given sender.

nodes.name: add_new_thread
nodes.summary: Public entry point that creates a new thread entry for a sender, delegating to `create_new_entry`.
